title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hook + metrics adapter
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a CI hook that runs per-prompt regression checks against baseline metrics and emits alertable Prometheus-style metrics. Backwards-compatible; opt-in via eval-harness config.
description:
Context: We need more targeted CI-level detection for prompt-set regressions (not just dataset-level aggregates). This PR introduces a lightweight CI hook that runs the eval-harness against a configured prompt-set baseline on push and exposes per-prompt delta metrics to our metrics pipeline. Motivation: earlier incidents showed subtle regressions on small but high-impact prompts that were masked by aggregate scores.

What this PR does: - Adds a CI hook (ci/workflows/eval-regression.yml) that runs the eval harness on changed models/configs and compares results to stored baselines. - Implements a per-prompt comparison engine (eval-harness/hooks/prompt_regression_hook.py) that computes absolute and relative deltas and classifies regressions using configurable thresholds. - Adds a metrics adapter (eval-harness/metrics/adapters/prometheus_adapter.py) to emit per-prompt delta gauges and an overall regression_count counter so alerts can be built in Alertmanager. - Adds unit and integration tests (tests/eval/test_prompt_regression.py) and test fixtures for edge cases (missing baselines, partial run failures). - Documents usage and rollout steps (docs/eval/regression-ci.md) and provides default thresholds (eval-harness/config/default_thresholds.yaml).

Checklist:
- [x] Hook implementation and metrics adapter
- [x] Tests covering positive/negative regression cases and flaky handling
- [x] CI workflow to run the hook on push and nightly baseline runs
- [x] Documentation and rollout notes
- [x] Backfill script omitted (will follow in a small ops PR)

Commits summary: Initial commit adds the hook and adapter, second commit adds tests and CI workflow, third commit tightens thresholds after test failures, fourth commit updates docs.

Changed areas: eval-harness core hook, Prometheus adapter, CI workflow, tests, docs, config defaults. This is intentionally scoped to eval-harness to keep risk low.

Review and testing notes: Tests were run locally and in CI; there were two initial flaky tests related to time-based thresholds which were addressed by switching to deterministic fixtures. CI status now shows all checks passing. We will roll this out as opt-in (config flag) and enable for a small set of repos before broader rollout.

Merge: Squash merge into main after approvals.

Why this is safe: No changes to runtime production code; only introduces an observability/CI integration. Thresholds are conservative by default and can be tuned via the config file.
